name: SBI General Arogya Sanjeevani Policy

room_rent.quote: Room Rent, Boarding, Nursing Expenses as provided by the Hospital / Nursing Home up to 2% of the sum insured subject to maximum `5,000/ par day.
room_rent.note: ICU/ICCU expenses up to 5% of sum insured subject to maximum of Rs 10,000/- per day.

proportionate.quote: In case of admission to a room/ICU/ICCU at rates exceeding the aforesaid limits, the reimbursement/payment of all other expenses incurred at the Hospital, with the exception of cost of medicines, shall be eģected in the same proportion as the admissible rate per day bears to the actual rate per day of Room Rent/ ICU/ICCU charges.

copay.quote: Each and every claim under the Policy shall be subject to a Co-payment of 5% applicable to claim amount admissible and payable as per the terms and conditions of the Policy.

waiting_initial.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the Ĥrst policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident, provided the same are covered.

waiting_ped.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the Ĥrst policy with us.

specific_waits.quote: All internal and external benign tumours, cysts, polyps of any kind, including benign breast lumps.
specific_waits.label: Benign tumours, cysts, polyps

specific_waits.quote: Piles, Fissures, and Fistula in Anus
specific_waits.label: Piles, Fissures, and Fistula in Anus

specific_waits.quote: Pilonidal sinus, Sinusitis and related disorders
specific_waits.label: Pilonidal sinus, Sinusitis and related disorders

specific_waits.quote: Prolapse inter Vertebral Disc and Spinal Diseases unless arising from accident
specific_waits.label: Prolapse inter Vertebral Disc and Spinal Diseases

specific_waits.quote: Calculi in urinary system, Gall Bladder and Bile duct, excluding malignancy.
specific_waits.label: Calculi in urinary system, Gall Bladder and Bile duct

specific_waits.quote: Treatment for joint replacement unless arising from accident
specific_waits.label: Treatment for joint replacement unless arising from accident

sublimits.quote: treatment of Cataract, subject to a limit of 25% of Sum Insured or `40,000/-, whichever is lower, per each eye in one policy year.
sublimits.label: Cataract Treatment

sublimits.quote: The following procedures will be covered (wherever medically indicated) either as in patient or as part of day care treatment in a hospital up to 50% of Sum Insured, speciĤed in the policy schedule
sublimits.label: Modern Treatment Procedures

exclusions.quote: Expenses related to any admission primarily tor diagnostics and evaluation purposes. Any diagnostic expenses which are not related or not incidental to the Current diagnosis and treatment
Expenses related to any admission primarily for enforced bed rest and not for receiving treatment.
exclusions.text: Rest Cure, rehabilitation and respite care (Code- Excl05)

exclusions.quote: Expenses related to the surgical treatment of obesity that does not fulĤl all the below conditions
Expenses related to any treatment, including surgical management, to change characteristics of the body to those of the opposite sex.
Expenses for cosmetic or plastic surgery or any treatment to change appearance unless for reconstruction following an Accident, burn (s) or Cancer or as part of medically necessary treatment
Expenses related to any treatment necessitated due to participation as a professional in hazardous or adventure sports
Expenses tor treatment directly arising from or consequent upon any Insured Person committing or attempting to commit a breach of law with criminal intent.
Expenses incurred towards treatment in any hospital or by any Medical Practitioner or any other provider speciĤcally excluded by the Insurer
Treatment for, Alcoholism. drug or substance abuse or any addictive condition and consequences thereof (Code- Excl 12)
exclusions.text: Alcoholism, drug or substance abuse (Code- Excl 12)

exclusions.quote: Treatments received in heath hydros, nature cure clinics, spas or similar establishments or private beds registered as a nursing home attached to such establishments or where admission is arranged wholly or partly for domestic reasons. (Code- Exel13)
exclusions.text: Treatments in health hydros, nature cure clinics, spas (Code- Excl13)

exclusions.quote: Dietary supplements and substances that can be purchased without prescription, including but not limited to Vitamins, minerals and organic substances unless prescribed by a medical practitioner (Code- Excl14)
exclusions.text: Dietary supplements and substances without prescription (Code- Excl14)

exclusions.quote: Expenses related to the treatment for correction of eyesight due to refractive error less than 7.5 dioptres.
Expenses related to any unproven treatment, services and supplies for or in connection with any treatment.
Expenses related to sterility and infertility this includes: i. Any type of sterilization ii. Assisted Reproduction services iii. Gestational Surrogacy iv. Reversal of sterilization
Medical treatment expenses traceable to childbirth (including complicated deliveries and caesarean sections incurred during hospitalization) except ectopic pregnancy; ii. Expenses towards miscarriage

War (whether declared or not) and war like occurrence or invasion, acts of foreign enemies, hostilities, civil war, rebellion, revolutions, insurrections, mutiny, military or usurped power, seizure, capture, arrest

Nuclear, chemical or biological attack or weapons, contributed to, caused by, resulting from or from any other cause or event contributing concurrently or in any other sequence to the loss, claim or expense.
exclusions.text: Nuclear, chemical or biological attack or weapons

exclusions.quote: Any expenses incurred on Domiciliary Hospitalization and OPD treatment
Treatment taken outside the geographical limits of India
